description: This file defines a class 'SymbolSet' which encapsulates sets of character encoding ranges, including predefined sets like Latin-1, Cyrillic, Hebrew, Emoticons, and Dingbats, and allows creation of custom sets through constructor.

classes.name: SymbolSet
classes.description: Represents a set of character encoding ranges used to define various character sets, with static predefined sets and the ability to create custom sets via constructor.

methods.name: SymbolSet
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SymbolSet with a collection of ranges, throwing an exception if the input is null.
